definitions.explanation: A bird that travels seasonally between regions, typically for breeding or food.

examples.japanese: {渡|わた}り{鳥|どり}が{飛来|ひらい}した。
{秋|あき}になると{渡|わた}り{鳥|どり}がやってくる。
examples.english: Migratory birds come when autumn arrives.

examples.japanese: この{湿地|しっち}は{渡|わた}り{鳥|どり}の{重要|じゅうよう}な{中継地|ちゅうけいち}だ。
examples.english: This wetland is an important stopover point for migratory birds.

notes:
{渡|わた}り{鳥|どり} refers to birds that migrate seasonally.

FORMS:
- {渡|わた}り (crossing, migration) + {鳥|どり} (bird)

COMMON MIGRATORY BIRDS IN JAPAN:
- {白鳥|はくちょう}: swan
- {雁|がん}: wild goose
- {鶴|つる}: crane
- ツバメ: swallow

RELATED WORDS:
- {留鳥|りゅうちょう}: resident bird (non-migratory)
- {夏鳥|なつどり}: summer visitor (bird)
- {冬鳥|ふゆどり}: winter visitor (bird)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {渡|わた}り{鳥|どり}が{飛来|ひらい}する: migratory birds arrive
- {渡|わた}り{鳥|どり}の{群|む}れ: flock of migratory birds
